Most teams overpay for US dedicated GPU servers because they size VRAM for model weights alone—forgetting KV cache, concurrency, and backward-pass spikes.

Quick weights-only reality check:
• 8B (16-bit): ~16 GB → 24 GB GPU
• 14B (16-bit): ~28 GB → tight on RTX 5090 (32 GB); safer on L40S (48 GB)
• 32B (16-bit): ~64 GB → A100 80 GB
• 70B (4-bit): ~35 GB → 48 GB GPU
